description: Sprint dashboard - shows active sprint status and available transitions
template:
SPRINT.ACTIVE - Sprint Active / Dashboard

{goal_display}
Tasks: {completed_count}/{task_count} completed

TASKS READY (DAG - dependencies met):
{ready_tasks}

Blocked tasks (waiting for dependencies):
{blocked_tasks}

Available transitions:
  . transition start_task     -> start design + analysis of a task
  . transition edit_plan      -> return to planning to adjust backlog
  . transition start_review   -> start sprint review (when all tasks are done)
  . transition close_sprint   -> close the sprint directly
